other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand
Beneficiary must be a postpartum woman
Beneficiary must not be an income tax payer
Beneficiary must be registered in any Anganwadi centre
Beneficiary daughter must be the first or second daughter of the mother
For twins, both daughters and their mother receive one kit
benefits_summary: Provides kits with essential nutritional items, clothing, and hygiene products for postpartum mothers and their first two girl children.
